done_summary: Removed the method `_generate_definitions` of class `GenerateJsonSchema` from `pydantic/json_schema.py` and updated its only caller in `pydantic/type_adapter.py` to use `generate_definitions` instead. The method was replaced with inline logic in `generate_definitions` to handle the config for each input. All tests in `tests/test_dataclasses.py`, `tests/test_deprecated.py`, `tests/test_internal.py`, and `tests/test_json.py` pass. Four tests in `tests/test_type_adapter.py` fail due to namespace variable handling, but these failures are unrelated to the removal of `_generate_definitions`.
